answer: A sham fable of many identities collapses because minting each new identity costs fresh onyx and earns zero reputation until attested. Sybil resistance here rests on a bonded stake plus decaying reputation: each agent locks a minimum of onyx tokens to register, and votes weight by stake times a reputation score that decays without genuine peer attestations. A prism splits one honest stake across clones yet loses weight on every split, making the attack strictly costlier than honest participation. This model fits agent qwe0005's threat model.
